whitepaper.title: 2026 座舱 AI 行业趋势白皮书
whitepaper.summary: 观察八个受测版本与六大功能域，探讨座舱 AI 的产品演进。
findings: 竞争正在从通用问答转向场景整合，能力组合比单一总分更能解释产品差异。
语言与知识已形成基础，连续任务、反馈与多模态仍存在体验缺口。
围绕真实用车任务组织研发与评测，持续衡量效果、效率、性能和成本。
outline: 行业全景与六域表现
场景竞争与标杆路径
年度趋势与产品建设重点

en.title: 2026 Cockpit AI Industry Whitepaper
en.summary: Eight tested versions and six domains reveal how cockpit AI is evolving.
findings: Competition is moving from general answers to integrated scenarios; capability profiles explain product differences better than a single score.
Language and knowledge provide a foundation, while task continuity, feedback and multimodal delivery still have gaps.
Organize development and evaluation around real vehicle tasks, considering effectiveness, efficiency, performance and cost.

fallback.title: 当座舱 AI 帮不上忙：从失败话术到任务恢复
fallback.summary: 基于30条实际测试记录，研究失败反馈、接管指引与任务恢复。
findings: 失败反馈的价值，在于帮助用户继续推进任务，而不只是说明“暂时做不到”。
报告区分能力解释、手动指引、界面接管与恢复路径，指出不同兜底方式的体验差异。
现有记录支持行为分析；是否真正恢复并完成任务，需要后续实测验证。
outline: 失败后的行为分类
典型案例与恢复机制
产品设计与复测建议
fallback.scope: 受测版本与样本范围、完整图表、案例分析及方法说明，详见完整报告。

en.title: When Cockpit AI Falls Short: From Failure Responses to Task Recovery
en.summary: 30 real test records examining failure responses, handover guidance and task recovery.
findings: Failure responses should help users continue a task, rather than merely explain that it cannot be done.
The report distinguishes capability explanations, manual guidance, interface handoff and recovery paths.
Existing records support behavioral analysis; verified recovery and eventual completion require further testing.

zeekr9x.title: 极氪 9X 座舱 AI 专题报告
zeekr9x.summary: 基于855条 BeeEVAL 记录，分析极氪9X六域表现、场景成绩、行业样本对标与改进优先级。
outline: 六域画像与细分场景成绩
行业对标与真实案例
改进优先级与复杂性分析
findings: 知识与出行形成相对优势，车控兑现仍是优先改进项。
路线规划与车书知识表现较强，车控对象修正和补能条件筛选存在差距。
结合六域画像、行业样本与真实案例，明确产品亮点和改进优先级。

en.title: ZEEKR 9X Cockpit AI Study
en.summary: 855 BeeEVAL records covering six-domain performance, scenarios, industry benchmarks and improvement priorities.
findings: Knowledge and travel are relative strengths, while reliable vehicle control remains an improvement priority.
Route planning and vehicle knowledge are stronger; correcting control targets and filtering charging conditions show gaps.
Domain profiles, industry samples and real cases identify product strengths and improvement priorities.

l9livis.title: 理想 L9 Livis 座舱 AI 单车专题报告
l9livis.summary: 基于889条 BeeEVAL 记录，分析常用任务的兑现基础、六域表现及动态信息与生成能力边界。
outline: 六域表现与场景成绩
行业样本对标与产品亮点
改口、动态数据与能力边界
findings: 常用用车任务具备较好的兑现基础，动态信息与生成能力仍有明确边界。
车书知识、组合操作与使用指导是优势，改口和动态服务需要进一步完善。
总体分数之外，报告拆解六域与细分场景，区分常用任务优势和完整能力范围。
l9livis.scope: 受测版本与样本范围、完整图表、案例分析及方法说明，详见完整报告。

en.title: Li Auto L9 Livis Cockpit AI Study
en.summary: 889 BeeEVAL records examining everyday task completion, six-domain performance, live information and generative capabilities.
findings: Common vehicle tasks have a strong delivery foundation, while dynamic information and generation retain clear limits.
Vehicle knowledge, combined operations and usage guidance are strengths; corrections and dynamic services need further work.
Beyond the overall score, domain and scenario analysis separates everyday strengths from the full capability scope.

travel.title: 蔚来出行 AI 专项对标与改进建议
travel.summary: 围绕目的地、路线与补能，分析蔚来 ET5 出行任务的体验差距。
findings: 出行体验的关键，是从“回答问题”走向“完成任务”。
ET5的差距集中在多目的地、条件修正、口语需求与目的地串联。
报告按任务选择可学习的标杆，将理解、任务状态和服务连接转化为改进方向。
outline: 出行任务与行业差距
典型案例与任务链诊断
标杆机制与改进建议

en.title: NIO Mobility AI: Benchmarking and Improvement
en.summary: Destination, routing and charging tasks reveal experience gaps in NIO ET5.
findings: Travel experience depends on moving from answering questions to completing tasks.
ET5 gaps concentrate in multiple destinations, condition changes, conversational requests and destination sequences.
Task-specific benchmarks turn understanding, task state and service integration into concrete improvement directions.

multi-stop.title: 多点行程规划：品牌对标与产品启示
multi-stop.summary: 比较多品牌的多点行程规划表现，结合典型案例分析任务机制、执行差距与可复制的产品改进。
outline: 品牌表现与标杆选择
四类规划任务与六个典型案例
可复制的任务机制与产品改进
findings: 极氪是优先学习对象，银河的执行表现也值得重点研究。
多点规划的难度来自顺序、约束和任务衔接，不能只用站点数量衡量。
通过典型案例提炼可复制的规划与执行机制，而不止比较品牌排名。
multi-stop.scope: 受测版本与样本范围、完整图表、案例分析及方法说明，详见完整报告。

en.title: Multi-stop Trip Planning: Brand Benchmarks and Product Insights
en.summary: Compare multi-stop planning across brands through cases, execution gaps and transferable product improvements.
findings: Zeekr is a priority benchmark, while Galaxy execution performance also deserves close study.
Planning difficulty comes from order, constraints and task continuity, not simply the number of stops.
Representative cases reveal reusable planning and execution mechanisms beyond brand rankings.

i8-livis.title: 理想 i8 → L9 Livis 座舱 AI 能力变化报告
i8-livis.summary: 比较 i8 与 L9 Livis 的跨车型、跨期测试表现，区分任务能力增强、功能取消与小样本波动，分析产品取舍和持续短板。
outline: 总体变化与同类任务比较
能力增强、功能取舍与测试波动
技术链路、用户体验与验证建议
findings: Livis阶段总体表现改善，但局部变化需要分别审视。
多地点与组合任务组织增强，图像生成取消属于功能范围取舍。
小样本比例波动不等于能力退化；持续短板与明确功能取消应分别验证。

en.title: Li Auto i8 → L9 Livis: Cockpit AI Capability Evolution
en.summary: Compare i8 and L9 Livis across vehicles and collection periods. Distinguish capability gains, feature removal and small-sample variation to assess product trade-offs and persistent gaps.
findings: Overall performance improves in the Livis stage, while local changes require separate review.
Multi-destination and combined task organization improve; image generation removal is a product-scope choice.
Small-sample fluctuations do not establish regression; persistent gaps and explicit removals require separate validation.
